input_contract.decoder_rows_searched: data-dependent; record actual rows; <= fixed decoder_input_rows; early activation never truncates model/cache/full input clock consumption
input_contract.input_transformations: none beyond existing approved FLEURS PCM16 derivation; do not regenerate/requantize/normalize/crop/concatenate/loop

numerical_verification_before_acoustic.exact_numerical_requirements: Retain prior canonical interface tolerances: fbank/splice abs1e-3, CMVN abs2e-4, final raw unrounded interval worst-distance <=1e-4+1e-5*minimum_interval_abs; unrounded probability interval abs1e-5, range/rowsum1e-5; exact canonical decoder non-score fields and score abs1e-5; cache/state/shape/finite geometry exact, whole/ragged bit-exact; independent local arithmetic bounds. Authority must use the NEW candidate weights with unchanged CMVN and frozen FP32-storage/FP64-accumulation semantics. Do not compare changed-weight logits to old-weight outputs or widen tolerances.
numerical_verification_before_acoustic.old_contract_scope: The historical contract binds only original A20. Historical failures and unavailable original tensors remain unchanged. It is not automatically a qualification certificate for step300.
numerical_verification_before_acoustic.qualification: Candidate-weight numerical verification is required before acoustic evaluation; finite fixtures do not establish all-input quality.

primary_acceptance.comparison: Run frozen compare() against immutable historical Qwen baseline; additionally compare with complete same-environment original pass. Require same-environment original event presence/count/discrete event coordinates to reproduce historical trace, otherwise report BASELINE_DRIFT and no automatic candidate acceptance. Preserve raw score/logit differences; old-host timing is never reused.
primary_acceptance.gain: At least one original miss (qwen3-kw1-serena or qwen3-kw2-eric) recovered OR zero events on original qwen3-repeat-nihao-eric false-trigger source.
primary_acceptance.greedy: K1/K2 presence, token edit distance and greedy exactness are separate diagnostics and never prerequisites for wake-hit acceptance.
primary_acceptance.integrity_prerequisite: All20 sources, WAV/PCM and label/voice/split/text identities exact, all feed/finish/callback coverage validated. Missing/partial/error is invalid, never zero events. Every event retained, never deduplicated.
primary_acceptance.no_regression: No lost originally detected positive; no increase in per-source opposite-keyword event count; no additional matching repeat; no increase in K1/K2 events on any confusable; no additional total repeated event per source.
primary_acceptance.split_reporting: train12 separately; Serena development_a4 separately; Eric development_b4 separately. Serena/Eric are already exposed nongradient diagnostics, not holdout.
primary_acceptance.stop: If no gain, stop this candidate. Any primary regression means screen FAIL. No extension, retry or second candidate.

resources.comparison: Publish candidate-original absolute differences and candidate/original ratios only for commensurate valid fields; no5%/10% threshold invented. Same-structure gate and operational limits do not establish board/product budgets. Performance result is DESCRIPTIVE_SINGLE_PAIR, no statistical PASS.

native_timing_scope.process_cpu_ns: post-GO payload-init to pre-final-record; starts after dlopen and GO, includes payload loading/initialization and prior trace JSON, excludes final run_end JSON, free and dlclose
native_timing_scope.rusage_counter_scope: native maxrss/fault/block-I/O counters are process-lifetime observations through the pre-final-record getrusage, not post-GO deltas
native_timing_scope.wall_ns: post-GO payload-init to pre-final-record; starts after dlopen and GO, includes payload loading/initialization and prior trace JSON, excludes final run_end JSON, free and dlclose
native_timing_scope.whole_process_envelope: supervisor_launch_to_reap_wall_seconds covers the whole collector process plus surrounding local setup, output drain and finalization; use this existing envelope for process/loader overhead

resources.pair_design: One fresh collector process per arm, original first then candidate. Same CPU/image/OS/compiler/ABI/system-library hashes and numerical kernel sources/flags, affinity to same available CPU,1thread, no parallel acoustic or heavy jobs; same source bytes/order and raw JSON flush behavior. Input/model hashing before both measurements inherently warms filesystem; do not claim cold-cache. No cache dropping or hidden warmup; each stream state reset. Original first order bias disclosed; single pair does not estimate variance.
required_metrics: Internal post-GO payload-init through pre-final-record CPU and wall, with exclusions stated
Supervisor launch-to-reap wall and process user/system CPU for whole-process overhead
Per-source/feed/finish service CPU and wall including callback output
Peak and sampled RSS, address space, thread and child observations with uncertainty
I/O availability, output sizes, allocator/arena/model sizes, complete call and row counters
Same environment, compiler, flags, ABI, libraries, affinity and exact source/input identities
resources.same_ABI_rule: Exact original/candidate equality in parameter count, payload bytes, architecture/dimensions, CMVN count, model-cache bytes and forward-MAC formula. Arena/state sizeof/symbol/layout must be equal under the SAME compiler/ABI. Historical333704 arena/1898984 arena+weights are reference-host figures; any target-ABI difference is separately explained, not assumed board growth. Unchanged paired code must not acquire hidden buffers.

structural_identity.acceptance: parameter count/payload bytes/cache/state/arena/MAC formulas must not grow; independently compare same compiler/ABI symbols and layout before native candidate evaluation

resources.unavailable: Optional I/O or owned-PID child interface missing => null+exact error/status, never0; distinguish last successful observation from final. Critical RSS/threads missing fails closed. Sampling does not prove uninterrupted lifetime compliance or no descendants.

rights_and_data_boundary.natural_sources: Only already admitted source identities and transformations, held separately. No new download, transfer, or publication.

secondary_observation_policy.Cosy12: All12 exposed source outputs, K1/K2 count/presence, repeats, removed/added/shifted events and runtime errors retained. No per-row truth from aggregate human/ASR tiers. Until exact pre-existing label authority is bound before release, these are behavior changes only, not missed/false classifications. No gradient/calibration.
secondary_observation_policy.D20: Report every weak full-transcript/greedy edit/exactness loss and weak event presence/count/wrong-keyword/repeat gain or loss against paired original native output; separately retain historical original official-FP32 fit records (20/20 weak exactness,11 weak positive hits,9 foil zeros). Labels remain weak. New weak event losses/increases are a regression flag; never call weak labels human truth. Greedy regression alone does not redefine wake success.
secondary_observation_policy.DEMAND: One existing complete 300.004-second DEMAND source. Historical zero events; audio keyword content UNKNOWN and verified-negative hours zero. All added or removed events are unadjudicated behavior changes. No expected-zero truth gate, blank CTC target, or FA/h denominator.
secondary_observation_policy.FLEURS20: Twenty existing FLEURS validation sources in 19 sentence groups; group dependence is preserved in the complete contract. Only the existing PCM16 derivatives are used. All historical K1/K2 events and all added, removed or shifted events remain in the separately held full trace. Text-target absence is audio-unaudited; overlap and source-person independence are UNKNOWN. Changes are unadjudicated observations, not verified false-activation improvement.
secondary_observation_policy.N0: Three complete300s constructed nonspeech streams; any added event is a constructed-control regression. Never count900s as real-world negative-hours evidence.
secondary_observation_policy.decision: Qwen primary signal may only be reported as an exposed development-screen result. Any D20 weak-event or N0 constructed regression blocks automatic next-stage recommendation. Cosy/DEMAND/FLEURS changed unadjudicated behavior yields REVIEW_REQUIRED, not automatic quality PASS/FAIL. Preserve all sourcewise data even when aggregate improves. No secondary analysis can promote this candidate to product/holdout qualification.

stage_order: separate candidate canonical reference and native numerical verification
saved-only complete scoring and independent audit
trace_integrity: All sourcewise errors, missing/partial calls, wrong words, repeated events and all gains/losses remain mandatory in the complete held contract. Aggregates never replace raw traces.
